full_judgment: Latifur Rahman, J.— This appeal by the pre-emptor-appellant is against the judgment and order dated 17.2.92 passed by a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division making the Rule absolute in Civil Revision No. 81 of 1987 after setting aside the judgment and order dated 9.12.86 passed by the District Judge, Madaripur in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 66 of 1986, who in turn reversed the judgment and order dated 24.4.86 passed in Miscellaneous Case No. 16 of 1985 by the learned Subordinate Judge, Shariatpur dismissing the application under Section 96 of the East Bengal Estate Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
